description: Perturbation biology: auditing whether a claim about what a perturbation does to a biological system deserves belief, and under exactly which context. Built around evidence denominators, recomputation from pinned data, and refutation before support. The pack never reaches VERIFIED — empirical support is always support for a frozen dataset, context, and analysis.

artifact_kinds: audit bundle: frozen claim, pinned sources, analysis inputs, and ledgers in one file
recomputed effect at the estimand-matching denominator, with a permutation null
model-versus-baseline receipt across the whole metric panel
examples: Does knocking down GENE-X with CRISPRi reduce the inflammatory signature in primary donor macrophages at 48 hours, measured by scRNA-seq?
Model M predicts perturbation responses better than a mean baseline on held-out perturbations in a Perturb-seq dataset. Is that claim supported?
Determine whether this compound's effect on the pathway replicates across donors, or only within the screen it was found in.
Is the reported differential expression driven by cell cycle and viability rather than by the perturbation itself?
Audit whether the published claim about the gene knockout is supported by the single-cell data actually deposited.
Does this virtual-cell model generalize to an unseen cell line, or is the held-out split leaking?
counter_examples: Prove that every graph with n vertices and more than n squared over four edges contains a triangle.
Prove or disprove that the sequence converges for every positive starting value.
Refactor the gene expression parser in our codebase to stream instead of loading everything into memory.
Write unit tests for the API endpoint that returns patient records.

corpus.description: Source ledger over the claim's literature and data: deterministic classification of what a source can support, accession discovery, retraction and correction state, and source-to-claim mapping. A preprint or a benchmark page can establish context or method and can never be the independent replication that lifts a claim, so the corpus records kind, not just identity.
corpus.version: ledger built per run; every entry pinned by accession, DOI, or URL

tiers.name: structural
tiers.description: Bundle shape, claim-freeze completeness, and evidence-graph connectivity. Every dimension of the claim is present (an explicit 'unknown' counts, silence does not), every claim node traces back to a pinned source, and the bundle's target hash matches the recomputed claim hash. Catches the failures that make every later check meaningless.
tiers.contamination_controls: Reads the bundle and the claim only. It has no access to the effect being claimed and cannot be tuned toward one.

tiers.name: executable
tiers.description: Recomputes the effect from the pinned metadata table at the estimand-matching denominator, then tests it by permutation within stratum. Reported numbers are ignored entirely. The negative-control contrast — the control condition split against itself — must come back silent.
tiers.two_sided_evidence: scripts/negative_control/ holds eight known-bad bundles — pseudoreplication, a pipeline that finds structure in its own control, context drift, a retracted source, scope escalation, an unresolved fatal contradiction, unrecorded confounder checks, and an edited preregistration. The tier must reject all eight and accept the one good bundle; scripts/check.py --self-test runs them.
tiers.contamination_controls: The adapter is fixed pack infrastructure; the bundle is produced per run by whoever is making the claim. The tier recomputes from the pinned table rather than reading any reported statistic, the frozen target hash is checked before and after, and the permutation seed and iteration count are fixed rather than chosen after seeing the result.

tiers.name: replication
tiers.description: The same claim against a second source that shares nothing with the first, under a separately pinned analysis path. Refuses more cells from the same donors, a second screen of the same line, and a re-analysis of the same accession — each is worth doing and none is replication. Grants the CHECKED_REPRODUCED refinement.
tiers.two_sided_evidence: scripts/negative_control/same_source_replicate_bundle.json pins the same accession as the primary and must be refused as a replication; scripts/check.py --self-test runs it.
tiers.contamination_controls: Independence is checked mechanically from the pinned accessions and preregistration hashes rather than asserted by the bundle.

receipt_format.freshness_rule: The receipt records the bundle's SHA-256 at check time and is stale the moment the bundle's current hash differs; the exit gate recomputes rather than trusting the recorded value. It is also stale if any pinned input hash has changed, because the analysis is only bound to the data it actually read — a receipt from an earlier version of the metadata table is a receipt about different data.

escalation.failure_signature: The pair (failure_class, first problem line with numbers, paths, and identifiers stripped). Two failures with the same pair are the same failure and escalate immediately. The count is two rather than three because each attempt here re-runs a pinned analysis over fixed data: if the second attempt produces the same failure signature, nothing the checker can see has changed, and a third will not differ either.

refute_attempt.name: permutation-null
refute_attempt.description: Shuffles the perturbation labels within stratum on unit-level means and requires the observed difference to sit outside the resulting null, and separately requires the control condition split against itself to come back silent. Shuffling within stratum preserves the batch structure so only the treatment assignment is destroyed; shuffling across batches would break the confounding too and make a confounded result look clean. A pipeline that finds a difference between two halves of its own control is measuring its own structure, and that is the check most likely to fail on a sincere, subtly broken analysis.

additional.name: denominator
additional.description: Classifies every metadata column against the unit taxonomy, checks the claim's biological unit can carry its estimand at all, checks that unit is crossed with the condition rather than confounded with it, and reports effective sample size across a grid of intra-cluster correlations. Applies the hard rejection rules. This is the most important gate in the pack: the dominant failure in this field is a correct number attached to the wrong denominator.

additional.name: context-protection
additional.description: Diffs the analysed context against the frozen claim dimension by dimension. The empirical version of weakening a target is quieter than the formal one: nobody rewrites the claim, they analyse a subset. The dose becomes the dose that worked and the sentence at the top never changes.

additional.name: provenance-trace
additional.description: Every claim element that needs a source has one in the ledger, and no source is retracted, withdrawn, or unresolvedly corrected. A retracted paper does not stop being cited; it stops being checked.

additional.name: scope-language
additional.description: Checks the report's vocabulary against the evidence tiers it declares. Association does not become mechanism, cellular does not become organismal, and nothing becomes therapeutic without the evidence each escalation requires. Not a word blocklist: the check is that the vocabulary and the evidence agree.

additional.name: contradiction-ledger
additional.description: Requires a list of sources that disagree, each with a resolution of resolved, unresolved-nonfatal, or unresolved-fatal. Prose dismissal is not a resolution. An empty ledger fails unless the search itself is recorded — every real claim in this field has something against it.

additional.name: confounder-sweep
additional.description: Requires a recorded result, not an intention, for each alternative explanation in data/confounders.json, plus the three required negative controls. A confounder completely confounded with treatment is a design failure no analysis fixes; a generic stress response that moves as much as the claimed pathway means the result is not specific.

additional.name: statistical-audit
additional.description: Estimand, identifiability, uncertainty at the matching denominator, multiplicity, minimum detectable effect, and prespecification. Held inside this pack until a statistics pack is registered, and it says so — the dependency is visible rather than forgotten. Multiple-testing correction offered as the answer to clustered cell-level uncertainty is itself a demotion trigger.

additional.name: leakage-audit
additional.description: For any model or generalization claim: whether the held-out axis actually held anything out. Severity follows the claim, not the overlap — leakage irrelevant to what is claimed is not a defect, and treating it as one trains people to route around the check.

additional.name: baseline-gate
additional.description: A predictive-superiority claim must beat the strongest simple baseline on every gate metric by a stated margin. Not on average, not on the headline. Baselines stay in the results table whatever the outcome.

additional.name: metric-panel
additional.description: The whole panel is reported, report-only metrics are never ranked on, and a rank that swings across the gate metrics is flagged rather than resolved by choosing the flattering ordering. A missing metric counts as a failed one.

CHECKED_BOUNDED_EMPIRICAL.description: Recomputed from pinned data at the estimand-matching denominator, survived the permutation null and a silent negative control, with every blocking gate passed. Bounded by the frozen dataset, context, perturbation, analysis, and metric set, and silent outside them.

CHECKED_REPRODUCED.description: The bounded result survived a second source that shares no accession with the first, under a separately pinned analysis path, with agreeing sign and comparable magnitude. This is the strongest status the pack can reach.

CONDITIONAL_WITHIN_SCREEN.description: A guide-conditioned or realized-screen effect that holds inside the screen it was measured in, conditional on assumptions about exchangeability that the design cannot discharge. Legitimate and narrow; it is not a population claim and must never be reported as one.

REJECTED_DENOMINATOR.description: Refuted by design rather than by data: the evidence cannot speak about the unit the claim is about. Recorded separately because the remedy is a different experiment, not a different analysis.
